alternatives.name: Use total=True/False with per-key overrides
alternatives.description: Keep the existing total parameter but add per-key override markers inline.
alternatives.reason_rejected: The total parameter already provides a default, but mixing it with per-key overrides in the same class creates confusing interactions.

alternatives.name: Use Optional[] for not-required keys
alternatives.description: Reuse Optional[T] to mean 'this key may be absent' in TypedDict.
alternatives.reason_rejected: Optional means 'T or None', not 'key may be absent'. Conflating the two loses the distinction between a key that's present with value None and a key that's missing.
